clue.text: Understood female Democrat going outside party

indicators.note: the two single letters are placed around the party word, one either side of it

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for a Democrat in US politics
an at-home is a party held in one's own house

explanation.surface: A woman from the Democratic Party grasps something as she steps out of a gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: To have fathomed something is to have got to the bottom of it, so grasped or comprehended it.

clue.text: Warnings about Western females in charge

indicators.note: the two warning words sit around the letter for Western, enclosing it

parts.note: a golfer shouts fore as a warning to people ahead

explanation.surface: Cautions are given about Western women who are in positions of authority.
explanation.walkthrough: One clue word, 'Warnings', supplies both of the outer pieces; a golfer shouts the first of them before driving.
explanation.definitionFit: Women who supervise a group of workers or lead a jury are each a supervisor of that group.

clue.text: South American singer from Argentina dropping in, oddly

indicators.note: the two-letter word in is let fall out of the country's name before rearranging
taken in a strange way, signalling the remaining letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: A South American vocalist from Argentina drops in on us in a peculiar fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: Take IN out of ARGENTINA and rearrange what is left, ARGETNA, to get the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The tanager is a brightly coloured songbird of the Americas, so a singer from that continent.

clue.text: Where to put post -—- best with gloves on

definitions.meaning: an out-tray holding letters waiting to be sent, also a computer mail folder
to beat an opponent in a boxing match

explanation.definitionFit: An out-tray holds outgoing mail, and to outbox someone is to defeat them at boxing, wearing gloves.

clue.text: Spirit of airline carrying English people on time

indicators.note: the airline holds the following pieces inside it, as a plane carries passengers

parts.note: El Al is the Israeli national airline

explanation.definitionFit: An elemental is a spirit or supernatural being thought to embody one of the classical elements.

clue.text: South American vessel or one from China

explanation.definitionFit: A sampan is a small flat-bottomed boat used in Chinese harbours and rivers, so a vessel of that country.

clue.text: Blade wielded by masked man

parts.note: a surgeon wears a face mask in the operating theatre and wields a small knife

explanation.definitionFit: The surgeon's small sharp knife is held by a doctor whose face is covered while operating.

clue.text: Scoundrel's dreadful crimes leading to an indictment, ultimately

explanation.surface: A villain's terrible offences finally lead to his being charged in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A miscreant is a wrongdoer or villain, a synonym for a rogue.

clue.text: Area reduced to dust, out of water

parts.note: ground means crushed into powder

explanation.surface: A region crumbles to powder once it dries out.

clue.text: Organize travel with expedition

to go quickly on foot, expedition here meaning speed

explanation.definitionFit: To manage an enterprise and to move at speed on foot are both senses of the same short verb.

clue.text: Lord's asked to forgive this uninvited guest

parts.words: Lord's asked to forgive this uninvited guest

clue.text: Driver's energy taken to heart by composer

clue.text: Kept in dark, say, in hut

clue.text: West Indian players, in end, bat less badly

clue.text: Where list has been modified, formerly

clue.text: A neutral is converted to become a citizen elsewhere
